blurbs.xander-smith-guarantee: My man got first place in the regular season doing his own thing and thought, “Man, how can I make my team more like my brother’s, who doesn’t know anything about fantasy football?” And THEN, he proceeds to make an even worse team! Unbelievable, I was rooting for you Xander.
blurbs.steven-it-s-so-over: The only thing worse than Steven’s unoriginal team name is the fact that he drafted a rookie QB and TE in the 7th and 8th rounds, and the only thing worse than THAT is that he has 3 players from the Raiders in his starting lineup.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: This is where the teams actually start to get good, so I feel bad ranking Connor this low, since I don’t even dislike his team. But once you get past round 6, the picks get less and less good. I mean, his best FLEX player is Zeke. He unironically picked him in the 7th round of our draft, in the year of our lord 2024. C’mon man.
blurbs.matt-scientology: Matt saw that Justin Jefferson’s QB was going to be Sam Darnold and was like “yeah I need me a piece of that,” and then he saw Mahomes finish as the QB12 in PPG and was like “oh yeah give him to me as the QB4,” and then he saw Puka Nacua break nearly every rookie record at WR and finish as the WR7 in PPG and was like “hell yeah let me take a rookie WR in a worse offense as the WR7 off the board,” and now here’s his team I guess.
blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: Some good value picks in this team (ARich in the late 6th, Etienne in the 3rd, Devonta in the 5th, to name a few) but with Njoku starting at TE (TE17 in PPG with Watson at QB) and a starting WR room of Devonta Smith and Jayden Reed it’s like, there’s a lot to like, but not like, a lot to LIKE, you know?
blurbs.liam-ceedeez-nuts: Nico Collins in the 4th might be the best pick in this draft, but then Liam picked Austin Ekeler in the 8th, and the round before, instead of pairing the elite receiver with his QB, took a QB that had a crippling calf injury and a different crippling wrist injury. Confounding.
blurbs.tyler-kamara-your-magahomie-is-back: Did Tyler actually do research this year?? I mean, he took some solid WRs in the mid rounds, some solid RBs in the early rounds, and paired his WR1 with his QB. What did this person do with the Tyler we once knew?
blurbs.alex-short-kings: I was gonna rank my team lower, since as good as my first 7 players are I think the team kinda falls apart after that. But then I remembered I have Christian McCaffrey, and THEN I remembered that I’m the one writing these so I can do whatever I want.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: It’s hard to find a weak point in Nick’s team. The only reason I have Conner as his worst pick is because he’s kind of old and injury prone, and Nick maybe could have gotten better value. But I don’t even mind the pick. However, we all know Nick will have to deal with lots of injuries, and career-high performances from his opponents, because he always does. So he probably still won’t win, but hey at least the draft was nice.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: Obviously the QBs are a massive weak spot, but Cam got so much juicy value out of his WRs. I mean I don’t even like Nabers this year, but in the mid-5th as your WR4? That’s easy money. And sure he’s just okay, on an awful offense, but Stevenson in the 7th might have been even better value.
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: Every year, I think Rocco has the best draft (I mean I really don’t see any true weaknesses in his team, top to bottom). Yet every year, his team ends up being mid. So maybe this is the year that breaks the curse? Probably not, but here’s to hoping.

blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: Nick all of Sunday and Monday, despite being the week’s highest scorer, even after Chase scored a 41-yard TD immediately on Monday Night Football: “I mean I’m gonna lose. We all know I’m gonna lose, and Daniels is gonna have like 40 points, because of course he will.”
blurbs.matt-scientology: Mahomes sucks, Javonte sucks, he’s got no tight end, and he’s playing a Jaguar in his flex, and somehow Matt’s team is still managing to perform alright these past 2 weeks. Maybe a team with an average record that’s 6th in points shouldn’t be this high, but, who else would take his place? Everyone’s kinda mid this year, so when Matt inevitably has his team suck next week we’ll get yet another team in rank 3.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: I’m not the only one waiting for the shoe to drop, right? I mean, this can’t just keep working, can it? Sorry, I still haven’t really come to terms with this yet, it’s breaking my brain. Seeing Connor have a good team is like seeing that this guy is married to Salma Hayek. It’s like… no, that can’t be right, surely I’m just seeing things incorrectly. But no, you’re not. That guy gets to make sweet love to a straight up 10, and Connor is 6-0 with the number one RB in fantasy.
blurbs.tyler-kamara-your-magahomie-is-back: Tyler said he had a team name change ready for whenever he loses his first game, but at this rate, we might not even fuckin’ see it! I’ve run out of fun things to say or any quips, I mean I guess Stroud is kinda mid? That’s all I got really. Here’s to hoping he loses so I might have some more material to go off of for next week.

At least he still has the Mets, they couldn’t possibly lead to more disappointment!
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: Cam’s best argument for his team is that, despite the fact that he has one win through 4 weeks, he has the eighth-most points. Really grasping at straws there. I don’t know that Cameron’s truly a threat for the wings, but he’s definitely on Skyway Watch this week. Probably no Nabers, definitely no Amon-Ra, Puka’s out for another month, and still no QB. Vibes are low.
blurbs.xander-smith-guarantee: Xander escapes the basement, for now. Even without scoring a single touchdown, even with Allen scoring his worst total in years, even with starting Jamaal Williams as his RB2, the Smith Guarantee clawed their way to a victory in this week’s Toilet Bowl. And who knows, maybe things are starting to look up? The WR room is looking sneaky good right now, this might lead to more 80-point victories in the future.
blurbs.alex-short-kings: Finally, my team has the performance we’ve all been expecting them to have. Four injuries plus an injury to Achane’s QB means I’m stuck fielding an awful lineup and playing the waiting game until everyone comes back healthy. We’ll always have Jauan’s week 3, at least.
blurbs.austin-404-projections-not-found: It goes against every fiber of my being to rank this team in the single digits, but a 5-3 start means I must, despite my own objections. Who knew you could light your first three picks on fire and still not be in last place? What a stupid game we play.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: Just when we all thought this would lead to some positive momentum, Nick’s best player wins the season’s most unfortunate Turdy Award by (likely) tearing his ACL after his dumbass quarterback decided to dive at his legs. The only reason Nick’s ranking isn’t lower is because his bench went absolutely OFF this week, so at least there’s a sliver of hope, right?
blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: After a wet fart last week, Rich squeaks out a 2-0 week 4. Sure, the early-round picks are severely disappointing, and he had to play a guy named Brenton Strange at TE this week (no for real, that’s not a made up name, he’s a real guy), but the waiver wire pickups and late-round dart throws might actually pay off. And all things considered, it might be for the best if Richardson misses time, since Richard won’t feel obligated to play him anymore.
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: Still no head-to-head wins in four weeks, but three median wins out of four is a very solid foundation. Rocco’s out here with Deebo and Jameson Williams on his bench, and easily the most RB depth in the league. We’re gonna work this out, me and Rocco’s team. We’re really finding out our differences in communication and working through them, and our sex life is slowly returning to our relationship.
blurbs.liam-ceedeez-nuts: I still don’t know how to feel about Liam’s team, it keeps bouncing back and forth like a ping pong ball. Two losses every odd week, two wins every even week. Much like real testes, they expand and contract. I guess that means he’s due for a crap performance next week, so enjoy this while it lasts Liam.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: It finally happened. A small blip in the road for Connor’s team. We’ve found his Kryptonite: we can’t allow Saquon to keep having 30-point weeks, and we need Connor to keep starting Mark Andrews.
blurbs.matt-scientology: I don’t know how often we’ve seen a week where every single one of a team’s players scored a touchdown. I predicted a bad week for Matt last week, and instead we got this. So… I guess I predict a good week next week? Congrats on your week 5 win Matt! Now the question remains, what the hell does this new team name mean? And why is Matt’s logo a donut?
blurbs.tyler-kamara-your-magahomie-is-back: Another 2-0 week, a third straight 126-point performance, no major injuries, and the two 30-year-old running backs are somehow the best runners in the NFL. This is starting to look like Cameron-2015 levels of dominance. It’s getting tiresome talking about Tyler’s continual overperformances, so instead I’ll talk about how I went to Disney World last weekend and rode Avatar’s Flight of Passage in Animal Kingdom for the first time and had a wonderful experience. I would highly recommend that ride to anyone, it was super fun.

blurbs.steven-it-s-so-over: Steven said he doesn’t read anything in the power rankings except the blurb next to his team, so I’ll put the same effort into writing this as he does into reading it: Steven team bad before. Steven team get hurt. Steven team somehow good now? Steven team not last. Nobody know how.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: Vibes are as high as the mountains in Utah right now. Took a Swig and traded for a QB (probably overpaid, but that’s neither here nor there), got a 2-0 week while Amon-Ra and Nabers were off celebrating Oktoberfest, and had Rhamondre back to performing with Zion-like efficiency and talent. The team played dirtier than a coconut cream soda and left Richard saltier than the namesake Lake. Cameron soaks in victory this week 5.
blurbs.austin-404-projections-not-found: If you had told me after the draft that Austin would be .500 after 5 weeks I’d have laughed in your face, and then probably believed you. Sure, he’s 10th in total points, and was 9th this week, but everyone was hurt or on a bye; at least he’s not as bad as Xander. Although, Austin did WILLINGLY start Deshaun Watson this week, and it went as well as you’d expect, so maybe he deserves worse.
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: I really thought we could work this out, Daniel. One player scored over his projections, not even sixty seven total points. Things were finally looking up! I thought we were doing so well in counseling, but it turns out you’ve been sleeping around this whole time?? For shame. Our marriage is over. I’ve filed the papers. I don’t care that Gibbs was on a bye; Deebo got 2.5 points! You make me sick, Rocco.
blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: Some byes and injuries made this week difficult for Rich, but he was less than 5 points off of a 2-0 week. I can’t be TOO harsh, even though looking at his top 3 picks there’s not much to like, and he might not have a consistent QB or TE, and the lord and savior Bucky Irving had a wonderful sub-five-point performance. But I mean, what if this is the floor? Week 3 proved it’s not but, what if it is?
blurbs.alex-short-kings: We all know my team stinks, sure. But at a certain point, journalistic integrity compels me to rank based on results rather than vibes and feelings. I know I’m 9th in points and have the 2nd-best points allowed, but like, I keep winning. I’ve had a starting player get injured literally every single week this season. I had the fuckin’ first overall pick and he hasn’t played a goddamn snap yet. So you know what, I’m proud of my team’s mediocrity. May I continue to lose vs the median and win by scoring 85 points.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: Nick lost his top receiver for the season but it doesn’t even matter. Everyone came out and performed today; even Jordan Whittington, a guy that half the people in this league have never heard of, got 12.4 points without a touchdown. It seems Nick’s team has gotten its act together. The doors of the Sarasota/Bradenton metro area are safe… for now.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: The shoe is dropping a bit farther than expected. I guess I was right last week: Connor started Mark Andrews and Saquon didn’t get 30 points, and he’s left with another 0-2 week. I might be onto something here. I know he had like 6 byes and Taylor was hurt but I’m ignoring that because it doesn’t fit my argument.
blurbs.liam-ceedeez-nuts: For the first time this season, Liam is officially on a winning streak. The nuts are expanding, possibly swelling, after a near-130-point performance. Burrow is great, Flowers bounced back, and even a random waiver wire TE got 2 touchdowns. I guess I should eat my words after predicting a bad week last week, and week 6 should be in the bag for Liam too!

In a week where 11th-ranked Steven could only muster 70 points, and Josh Allen and Joe Mixon combined for over 50 points, you’d have maybe expected Xander to crawl out of the basement. But then you look at his team and it’s like, why the fuck should I ever have expected that?
blurbs.steven-it-s-so-over: Steven loses this week’s Toilet Bowl and can’t even manage to be the league’s 10th scorer to alleviate his misery and add a pity win to the record. I don’t know that you needed to add the “Really” to the team name, Steve; we’ve all seen your team, it was implied. At least the Mets are okay now, right?! Grimace, right bud?
blurbs.alex-short-kings: Alright, journalistic integrity be damned, I don’t care that I keep winning, my team fuckin’ blows. I know last week I said I hope I keep getting 85-point wins, but man this shit sucks. I couldn’t even get that this week! All of my RBs got hurt so I traded for RB depth, and the fucking depth guy got hurt too! I had to start a guy named Jeremy McNichols this week. I need Kupp and Tua and McCaffrey to just come back healthy, please, I can’t take another week of this, this sucks.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: Everybody hide your doors; vibes are not great in Nick land. He wins this week’s Turdy by starting Dak over Fields, Rice is now guaranteed out for the season, James Cook didn’t even play, and the Cardinals look mediocre. After being the league’s top scorer last week, Nick, wha happen?
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: No Utah puns this week, just straight to business. Even with getting goosed by Tre Tucker, Cam still pulls out a second-straight 2-0 week. These haven’t been overly convincing wins (both 5th against the median), but it’s a foundation to build off of; like when you’re building a big Lego house and you need that giant green flat piece to represent the grass and start building the base of your house. That’s Cam’s team right now: a big, flat, green Lego piece.

blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: Daniel, what are we? We had such a strong marriage at the beginning of the year, where I ranked you first for two straight weeks. And then your team was ass for a while, and you were sleeping around, so we got a divorce. And now your team is back to being good again? But it was so bad last week! I just want a team I can bring home to my parents, one that’s reliable and dependable and consistent. Your team can’t even manage that; every week is a new adventure with them. It’s too tumultuous, I need more stability before I can commit.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: Connor’s team continues its gradual descent into mediocrity. When Taylor gets back, things SHOULD get better, but Saquon is starting to look human, and Calvin Ridley just absolutely sucks. blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: In a week featuring a lot of mid, Rich’s team pulled off a solid performance. No 2-0 week is a bit unfortunate, but you build off of these performances. Still no team name change after last week’s first loss, a bit unfortunate that Tyler didn’t keep that promise. midseason-7.label: Mid-Season Report Card

blurbs.xander-smith-guarantee: Xander is getting very comfy in the league’s basement right now. He’s firmly last in points scored, traded away Diontae Johnson, lost one of his only good players in Shaheed for the rest of the year, and is relying on one-legged Nick Chubb to secure his RB room. There’s always a lot of unpredictability in football/fantasy, but it’s a certain kind of relieving to see that the guy everyone knew had the worst draft ended up with the worst team.
blurbs.steven-it-s-so-over: Steven’s saying “Thank God For Mississippi” in regards to Xander’s team. Under normal circumstances, having one median win halfway through the season and being in last place in the standings would cement you as 12th in the power rankings, but I suppose I could be a little lenient and project improvement for the coming weeks. I mean, Tua’s back for Tyreek, Davante’s back with Rodgers, and Steven no longer has to roster Aiyuk. It can’t get any worse, right?
blurbs.austin-404-projections-not-found: Honeymoon period is over, this team blows cock. It’s so bad that Mostert in the 3rd wasn’t even the worst pick. And yet, somehow, Austin finds himself at 7-7. Maybe he’ll waltz his way into the playoffs with the same devil-may-care attitude he exhibits in the real world. With Evans missing time, though, I say that’s unlikely.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: Given his record, it would take a lot for Nick’s team to make that second-half surge and make the playoffs. But his team is easily better than all of the teams around him in the standings, and he’s middle of the pack in total points scored. The only problem is, much like every other season, he’s 1st in points allowed. So, expect more door-slamming talk in the future.
blurbs.alex-short-kings: Some awful performances from my team this season, capped off yesterday with a nice 66-point week. You could easily argue this team should be even lower in the standings, however, a) I’m biased, and (more importantly) b) literally every important player for my team has been hurt. I mean the guy I took 1st overall literally hasn’t played a snap. But looking forward, LOTS of guys are returning from injury (Kupp, CMC, Tua for Achane). We could see a late-season surge from the Short Kings. Or not, and we could just as easily see me eating wings next September.
blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: Richard is (regrettably) our current title holder, so maybe it’s fair to say he’s experiencing a bit of Super Bowl hangover? I’ve not really been able to put heads or tails on Rich’s team this year; it’s kinda good, and there’s plenty to like, but compared to a few other teams in our league it’s arguably mid. But, Rich’s team last year was like, the absolute King of Mid, and we all know how that played out. So maybe we’re playing right into his trap.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: After a truly awful start from Cameron, there was a mutiny by the crew to throw Captain Waddle overboard in favor of the new Captain Purdy. Now, Cam’s team has righted the ship. Sure, Cam is only getting 5th and 6th in median every week, so the wins aren’t convincing, but hey, shut the fuck up nerd, you take the wins you can get. If Puka is healthy and good, this team is good. He might not be, though, and McCaffrey might come back and usurp Jordan Mason, but we’re not thinking about that possibility right now. Good vibes only.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: It took a few weeks, but Connor’s team is back on track, and that’s without Jonathan Taylor in the fold too. You might think this ranking is a little harsh based on the standings, but when you look closely, this roster has more holes than Spongebob; Ridley, Andrews, Taylor’s injury, Zeke in the 7th, and now Metcalf is hurt. However, much like Spongebob, the team finds a way to remain optimistic and fight on in the face of adversity. Let’s just hope this success continues and we don’t find Connor at the Bikini Bottom of our rankings (I just tried the Wendy’s Krabby Patty meal recently, so it’s been on my mind if you couldn’t tell).
blurbs.liam-ceedeez-nuts: It felt only fair that since Liam just edged out Connor in their marathon that he should also just edge him out in the mid-season rankings as well. It pisses me off that a team rostering 3 TEs and managed by a guy who was googling players during our draft is 4th in the standings, but such is the game we play. Who knows how good this team will be once Nico comes back?
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: Fuck it, I’m back in. Please forgive me for leaving babe, I wasn’t sure what I wanted, but now with Gibbs, Brown, and Daniels playing so well, and Cooper on the Bills, I need you back. I even gave you Chase Brown for free to show my commitment! Rocco, you’re 4th in points and only have 2 median losses on the year; it’s turning around. No more wayward eyes, a happy marriage lies ahead for me and your team.
blurbs.matt-scientology: After an atrocious week 1 losing to a McCaffrey-less me, Matt’s team has fired on all cylinders and not pumped the brakes even once. He even threw away his 4th round pick (and arguably his 2nd round pick too) and the team still looks good. Next year I think I should do a Matt and just draft on nothing but blind intuition, it seems to keep working.
blurbs.tyler-kamara-your-magahomie-is-back: It’s just bananas at this point. I don’t have anything funny to say. Ty has purposely gotten zero points from his TE for three weeks straight and he still has a perfect record against the median. Chris Godwin sacrificed his ankle for the squad parlay to hit and it didn’t even matter. Every time I think about Tyler’s team, I need to take a walk; it just pisses me off.

midseason-7.intro: Doing something a bit different this week: since the season is halfway over, I think it’s more appropriate to assess everyone’s entire seasons so far, as opposed to looking at just one week. The report card grades reflect my confidence in your team’s roster based on what we’ve seen so far, while the rankings are more of a combo of current performance + future projections. I think it’ll make sense once you start reading it.

blurbs.xander-smith-guarantee: More misery for the Xan man. At least it was kinda cool when he predicted that Tyreek would have exactly 6 catches on Sunday. Seemingly the only thing that went right for him. You know you’re in the shitter when you score 96 points and go 0-2 as the league’s 10th scorer: it’s just not your year, bud.
blurbs.steven-it-s-so-over: By the grace of God, Steven manages to scrape a win. Was it the ugliest win we’ve had so far this season? Yes. But, they all count the same. And in a season where he’s fighting to not eat the wings, every little bit is needed. Kinda sucks that Tyreek finally had Tua back and was just… fine. Maybe that’s emblematic of things to come.
blurbs.alex-short-kings: Perhaps this is some kind of karmic retribution for all of the wins I’ve stolen this year with my team scoring 80 points. Just a bad week all around for the ole A-dawg: my best performance in over a month and I still go 0-2, the Yankees are sharting all over themselves in the World Series, the Jets continue to be the biggest joke in professional sports, and they charged me for double meat at Cava on Sunday even though I asked for half and half. My season rests in the hands of the German Achilles Gods. *loud cartoon gulp noise to indicate my nerves*
blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: Richard’s team continues to be the epitome of mid. Average record, 8th in points scored, 7th on the week in points. It’s the Hilary Swank of teams: we don’t really know if she’s hot or not, and we can’t 100% agree, so we’re just gonna put her in the middle and say she’s okay.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: Alright now, things are starting to look up. The doors in the Everdina apartment are safe, and Nick’s team might be on a bit of a roll. Consistency and points allowed have been Nick’s greatest enemies this season — he’s not had a 1-1 week yet, just three 2-0 weeks and 5 0-2 weeks — so maybe I’m going out on a limb here by projecting positive regression. And maybe I’m going out on said limb because I’m worried about what Nick will say/do to me if I keep slandering his team.
blurbs.austin-404-projections-not-found: Sometimes in life, you try really hard at a hobby and you do everything you can to win, and a guy who goes off of nothing except last year’s stats drafts 3 awful picks in his first 3 rounds, then loses his best player to injury, and still beats you by 30. Life is funny that way, isn’t it?
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: I’ll say it: Cam has officially Turned It Around™. Maybe we should be worried about Jordan Mason being mediocre for the past month, and potentially losing a large majority of his value in two weeks time, but eh, 8-8 and another median win is probably good enough. The squad took a teambuilding vacation to Utah and came back rejuvenated; 7-1 over the last four weeks, hot damn.
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: I’m getting tired of this song and dance, Daniel. Every time I think we’ve turned it around, something like this happens. I don’t want to fight, but you leave me no choice with your behavior. Amari couldn’t even get one point! Daniels needed a last-second hail mary to reach his projections! This can’t be sustainable! I mean I know you’re still 5th in points, but, fuck Rocco, I can’t keep doing this to us. You need to decide what kind of team you want to be. For us. I can’t take this anymore.
blurbs.liam-ceedeez-nuts: The nuts are enlarging and the winning streak is back. CD finally played like his draft capital would suggest, Kyren was still great, and this is all WITHOUT Nico Collins. It’s fitting that Halloween is in two days because Liam’s team is starting to look spooky.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: Just when I thought Connor’s team would start sucking ass, they pull me back in. Pick those shoes back up, they’re done dropping. Connor is the week’s top scorer with Saquon underperforming, a starter scoring 1.4, and Metcalf not even playing. I think he got his swagger back.
blurbs.tyler-kamara-your-magahomie-is-back: Someone call M. Night, because this is a plot twist of epic proportions! But really, it’s been coming: Ty’s entire WR room is battling injury, with Godwin donezo monezo, Diggs going down, and Higgins missing half his games this year. The TE position is still a question mark. And now, the QB room is even turning on him. Obviously this team is still good, but just how good, exactly? Are we watching the Aaron-Rodgersification of Ty’s team in real time? Is he suddenly washed now?
blurbs.matt-scientology: We got some movement at the top! Yeah Matt didn’t go 2-0 this week, but this has been a long time coming. We haven’t seen an 0-2 week from him since week 1, and he’s managed to have the most depth in the league while also patching up the giant hole Mahomes left in his draft/QB room. Someone call Tom Cruise and the lady that voices Bart Simpson: I might want to join the church before it’s too late.

blurbs.steven-it-s-so-over: In what is some type of hilarious karmic justice, Steven is looking to be our league’s biggest loser this season. Through ten weeks, Steven has one (1) win against median. Davante is washed, Tyreek might be hurt, Jones might be hurt, he’s playing Taysom Hill as his flex, and Mayfield isn’t even playing this week. I can’t even think of a trade he could make to salvage this. I guess the only thing I can say is, prepare your asshole, and hope for a miracle in the playoffs.
blurbs.xander-smith-guarantee: Xander manages one win out of a possible four and extends his insurmountable lead over last place to two games. The team is starting to come together, at least. Ten weeks too late, but hey, better late than never. Although Xander did, for some reason, start Ezekiel Elliott this week. And Zeke’s fumble is what ultimately led to him going 0-2 vs. 2-0. So, he should be thankful I’m ranking based on the strength of his team and not his strength as a manager.
blurbs.alex-short-kings: Let’s look at the positives: despite being 10th in points and having only 2 median wins, I’m still in the hunt, and the player I picked first overall is FINALLY playing games. Just don’t look too hard at the standings, or point totals the last few weeks, or any like, underlying metrics. I’m just gonna bury my head into the sand and hope it works out.
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: Hey Rocco. I know it’s been a while since me and your team last spoke, but I just wanted to check in. I know after a breakup you’re supposed to not break No Contact but I could tell you haven’t been well. I saw Olave go unconscious on the field, Cooper isn’t playing either, Daniels had a bum week last week, Kincaid sucks. I thought giving you Chase Brown was me extending the olive branch, but it seems you’re only spiraling further. Let me know if you need any help, even though me and your team are exes I still care for them.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: I’ll say it: I might’ve been a bit too rash in declaring Cam’s team having officially Turned It Around™. Cam’s team is a lot like a cheesy monster movie, like Godzilla: King of the Monsters. There’s a lot of spectacle in the monsters/big names: Mothra/Malik Nabers, Godzilla/Amon-Ra St. Brown, Ghidora/Puka Nacua, Rodan/Brock Purdy. But then you look any deeper at the plot and performances of this team and it starts to lose its luster. So, here’s to hoping the rest of the season is Godzilla Minus One and not Godzilla (1998).
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: After starting the year 4-10, Nick’s team has gone 5-1 in the last 3 weeks, with three straight median wins and three straight 100-point performances. Since we know things will inevitably fall apart for Nick’s team, the fun questions then become: when will it happen, and who will be the main proprietor of this collapse? My guess: Week 12, and whatever waiver wire QB he’s using to replace Dak.
blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: Maybe Richard’s team isn’t hot, but she’s starting to look attractive. Stringing some wins together despite inconsistency, with a good amount of median wins sprinkled in too. Speaking from another guy with unreal PA luck: just ride it til you can’t anymore and block out the naysayers that will use it as a reason to discredit your team.
blurbs.austin-404-projections-not-found: Something in me is reacting viscerally to Austin’s team being 12-8. My relationship with it is similar to my relationship with parmesan cheese: everyone says it’s good, and it’s well-liked, so I should like it, but every time I try it I just can’t get into it and it makes me want to hurl. Also, Mike Evans was Austin’s best player, and once he got hurt, his team just got way better somehow? Idk, trying to make any sense of this team might give me an aneurysm.
blurbs.matt-scientology: Just when I was starting to get excited about Matt’s team they go full Hilary Swank and turn mid. Matt has had only one top-5 scoring week since week 5, and the team’s best players are starting to become less and less reliable. I was hoodwinked, bamboozled, led astray, run amok, and flat out deceived by this team’s inflated record. I see them for what they are now, which can be best embodied by one, singular emoji: 🤡.
blurbs.tyler-kamara-your-magahomie-is-back: During the week 8 power rankings I compared Ty’s team to Aaron Rodgers, and much like Rodgers, Tyler’s team’s reputation is crumbling at breakneck speeds. If there were a “teams in desperate need of a trade” power rankings Ty would be number 1, but sadly this is not that, and despite a great week 9 Ty’s time in the sun is fading. No good WRs or TEs, QB is a question mark, and the only 3 good players still have to take their BYEs. The wax wings are beginning to melt, Icarus.
blurbs.liam-ceedeez-nuts:
Last time I said the winning streak is back, but I don’t think that’s entirely accurate. It’d be better to say it’s SO back. Are we worried about CD not having a QB and not being able to catch a pass because of the sun? Maybe. But Nico’s (probably) back this week, and apparently Burrow is playing like an MVP and the wrist injury doesn’t bother him anymore, so it might not even matter. Are we gonna see a Leicester City type of resurgence from Liam’s squad to lead him to the title? 

I mean, no, we probably won’t, but wouldn’t it be cool if we did?
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: Boy was I wrong about Connor’s team. No DK? No PROBLEM. He’s got two great RBs, the best QB in the world, Andrews is starting to not be ass finally, Ridley is suddenly good, and we all just let him pick up Tyrone Tracy for free on a random Sunday morning. Is there any stopping this team? I suppose we as a country flashed back to 2016 this past week, so maybe our fantasy league should do the same and have Connor win the chip. It’s only fitting.

week-10.intro: We’re back with power rankings this week. Thank you for your patience; I’m sure last week’s absence was torturous for some of you. In what is the antepenultimate rankings release for this 2024 season, we’re finally seeing the playoff structure form its shape, these next four weeks will be crucial for the half of the league that are fringe playoff teams.

week-12.label: Week 12

blurbs.xander-smith-guarantee: The bottom of the power rankings was tough this week: Xander, Steven, Rocco, and I all had pretty solid performances in weeks 11 and 12. Ultimately, however, it had to go to someone, and who is more fitting than our preseason number 12 himself? He’s already been eliminated, is currently in last place, and he’s still rostering Ezekiel Elliott. Joe Mixon dragged this team’s near-lifeless body out of a burning building and resuscitated it in week 11, so he’s still not guaranteed the wings. With Mixon on a bye in week 14 though, I’m not liking the Xan Man’s chances.
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7: Some people get pleasure in watching their exes ruin their lives and spiral out of control — when I found out my ex was cheating on me, and then was lying about her cocaine usage and was secretly addicted, it might have given me some pleasure to hear how she was doing poorly and how all of her friends abandoned her. But this isn’t one of those cases; it gives me no joy to report on Rocco’s team’s shortcomings. A solid performance on Sunday might have saved him from being a repeat-offender wing eater, but with Daniels still on bye in week 14, and all of the awful injuries we’ve seen, I remain pessimistic.
blurbs.richard-to-infinity-and-bijan: Richard’s team went from Hilary Swank to Hillary Clinton these past 2 weeks. You could argue it’s unfair to rank him lower than a team that has already been eliminated from the playoffs, but then I could look at his point totals and median performances each of the last two games and argue that 10 might not be low enough. Things should get better in the final stretch, with no important players on bye and Pacheco/Smith hopefully returning. However, the damage may have already been done. The team has to wake up ASAP, otherwise this could spell disaster.
blurbs.steven-it-s-so-over: To keep this brief and answer the eponymous question: yes.
blurbs.alex-short-kings: Looks like burying my head in the sand worked. I want to give a special shoutout to Cooper Kupp for potentially saving my season with a garbage time touchdown on Sunday night. Making up two more games against Cameron or Matt will be a challenge, for sure, but you can’t count my team out until the final whistle. Despite only three median wins, I’m still here, still standing. So put up your dukes, boys, mister 10th in total points is comin’ for ya.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls:
What I wrote in week 10: “Since we know things will inevitably fall apart for Nick’s team, the fun questions then become: when will it happen, and who will be the main proprietor of this collapse? My guess: Week 12, and whatever waiver wire QB he’s using to replace Dak.”

Jared Goff’s week 12 performance: 269 yards, 0 TDs. 10.76 fantasy points.

Am I some kind of nostradamus? Not sure, you tell me 👀

No, but in all seriousness, it seems only fitting for Nick’s team to finally make its way back to .500 with another top-scoring week, only to all-but ruin his playoff chances by winning week 12’s Turdy award. It ain’t over, but it certainly ain’t looking good.
blurbs.matt-scientology: Something Bad is happening to Matt’s team. The beginning of the season looked Wonderful, and he was Dancing Through Life at the top of the standings. But now with zero median wins in the past month and zero weeks above 6th in scoring since week 5, Matt’s team is no longer Defying Gravity; they’re experiencing gravity in full force as they freefall and plummet to earth. We might be looking at a Finale for Matt if things don’t change, and with Nix, McLaurin, and Robinson all on bye next week, his team could be done For Good.
blurbs.austin-404-projections-not-found: Every time I write one of these, I think to myself, “Okay, Austin’s team did well, AGAIN, but surely this is the week it’ll fall apart for him.” Yet, here we are: it’s week 12 and Austin is an all-but-guaranteed playoff team. He has the lowest points against in the entire league, so even when he isn’t good, his team still musters wins. At this rate, fuck it, we should probably expect him to win the whole damn thing.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege:
Fourth in median scoring in week 11, fourth in median scoring in week 12, so 4th in the rankings feels appropriate. Now, Cam’s team isn’t quite home free yet; he’s only in 6th, one game up on 7th place, and only has a points tiebreaker over one playoff team. It’s really coming down to the wire for a lot of teams, and Cam has his right up in the muck, but his team certainly picked the right time to start getting hot.

I liken this team to the Oreo pie Cameron made us for our Friendsgiving: it looks a bit sloppy, and had some moments where it began to fall apart, but in the end it tasted oh so good.
blurbs.tyler-kamara-your-magahomie-is-back: I was right that the wax wings are melting for Ty and his team, but it seems the wall of wins his team built up through weeks 1-7 is high enough to shield him from the small implosion occurring from week 8 onward. I’m not quite sure this is truly the 3rd-best team, but I don’t feel too confident in too many of the teams around this, and Ty’s team keeps putting up solid performances in weeks he elected to not start players. So, maybe I’m being too harsh.
blurbs.liam-ceedeez-nuts: A small blip in form last week, but the team is back on track. Liam’s team is really taking shape this past month or so, and even with a few key players on bye last week he still managed a 2nd-place performance vs. median. Don’t look now, but this team might be a dark horse to take the whole thing.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: What else is there to say about Connor’s team? It looks like six guys took a week off (Dobbins didn’t even finish his game) but Lamar and Saquon combined for nearly 67 points and Connor was, yet again, the top scorer of the week. Without a Joe Mixon Monday Night Miracle, first place would be all but wrapped up for Connor. I don’t have any funny quips or witty remarks to make, I’m mostly just jealous. That’s all.

week-12.intro: Thank you all for being patient and for joining me in what is the penultimate power rankings blog of the 2024 fantasy football season. What a ride it has been; mainly for me, since I normally run out of juice writing these about halfway through the season. I have a couple of fun things planned for season’s end, so what may seem like a normal power rankings this week is a precursor for what’s to come. In the meantime, with so much at stake these last two weeks, here’s how it all stacks up:

playoff-14.label: Playoff Predictor

blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v7:
What I wrote after the draft: “Yet every year, his team ends up being mid. So maybe this is the year that breaks the curse? Probably not, but here’s to hoping.”

I think writing that meant I had a hand in your team’s fate, Rocco, and for that I’m sorry. I was really trying to manifest wins for you. I even married your team for a brief period of time! This really just happens every year and at this point I’m not sure what more can be done to stop it.

Regardless, what’s done is done, and you’re down here with us losers. Here’s to hoping you go wing free this year.
blurbs.alex-short-kings: It’s nothing short of hilarious that after scrounging together low-point wins all season, my team finally gets healthy, and I finally make a trade that balances out my lineup, and I have my best four-week average of the season, and THAT’S when things fall apart and I lose games. Not when I was starting Jeremy McNichols and Roschon Johnson and averaged like 75 points a week, but when I finally started averaging triple-digit weeks. Oh well, c’est la vie.
blurbs.xander-smith-guarantee:
Shame on me for ranking Xander last in the previous update. He said he’d win out in the last 2 months and he damn near did! Unfortunately, it wasn’t early enough to make the ‘yoffs, but this team really found their groove as of late. It helps when your QB has the best fantasy QB game of all time, I guess.



Playoff Teams
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege:
Cam’s team continues to bounce around, going from last in the league to 2nd in the span of a week. To think, had Brock Purdy just been not complete ass, all of this stress would’ve been avoided…

If only you still had him on your playoff roster. I might be inclined to rank you a bit higher. For now though, I remain wary that your team continues its hot and coldness and won’t be consistent enough over the three week playoff period.
blurbs.nick-cook-n-acls: He had to win out to make the playoffs and lo and behold he did. Everyone’s doors are safe and the team is looking really nice come playoff time. As much as I think this team is good, it’s fitting I ranked Nick in 2nd, since that’s where he usually finishes when he makes the playoffs.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: It’s only fitting that the number one team in our regular season has the best chances to win the whole damn thing. Some fantasy football research showed that 51% of fantasy managers that owned Saquon Barkley were in either 1st or 2nd in their league, so he alone might just be good enough to propel Connor to victory. If I had to put my eggs into one basket, it would be this one.

playoff-14.intro:
The regular season has ended, and we venture into the playoffs, where a team undeserving of the championship because it’s not my team will win a title. This week, since there are effectively two separate leagues, I’ll break down both of them and rank each team by their chances to win it all/not eat wings. This won’t be the last post of the season, but things are quickly wrapping up, and here’s the outlook of the league heading into the final three weeks:


Non-Playoff Teams

draft.label: Draft Recap

blurbs.austin-cyborg-squad: It is both extremely funny and extremely fitting that the first year the Machine starts drafting kinda decently and doesn’t massively overvalue top-tier QBs and TEs, it breaks halfway through the draft, leaving Austin to fend for himself and scramble to get it back working. Maybe you should just take this as an omen, Aug.
blurbs.richard-the-pollard-express: Is this ranking done in part because it’s funny to rank Richard’s draft this low after all the shit he talks? Yes. Is it also done in part because he has a poor WR room, a risky TE pick, a QB that hasn’t finished inside the top-10 in points per game in the last two seasons, and has the worst-ranked team according to a consensus of 110 fantasy experts? Also yes.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: You know, I can’t say I would ever advise someone to use their first-round pick on a near-30s running back who has both degenerative bilateral Achilles Tendonitis and a torn PCL. But every time Cameron drafted CMC it has worked before, so who am I to tell him he shouldn’t?
blurbs.xander-he-bleeds-pink: In a surprising twist, I actually don’t dislike this team at all. Sure, the RBs don’t inspire much confidence, but drafting strong WRs and depth while also taking a shot on an early RB and securing an elite QB and TE is really not a bad way to go about things. I think my only problem is with the RB and WR the machine picked early, but not the thought process itself. Maybe the machine started glitching out because it was making a worse team for its creator than it was for Xander?
blurbs.matt-the-team-formerly-known-as-jeanty-i: I wanted to rank this team higher, because I think Matt got great value with his first three drafted WRs. But then I was like, wait he got Cooper Kupp and Javonte Williams and both will play important roles for him this season? And then I was like, Joe Burrow in the 4th round? Nevermind, I’m good. Also, he didn’t get George Kittle for the first time in 3-4 years. That might be a sign that his team will underperform.
blurbs.tyler-team-strong-2025: Richard joked that Ty’s team is probably either a top-2 team or a bottom-2 team, so it’s fitting to have him end up right in the middle. I think it’s extremely realistic to expect that his guys will all perform well when they’re playing, because they’re all good, and also I think it’s extremely realistic to expect a good portion of his team to be injured for a lot of the season, due to both Ty’s fantasy luck and the average age and usage of his players.
blurbs.liam-rasheez-nuts: Liam passed up on the number one player, took two Jets players back-to-back, and ended up with two guys suspended for a total of nine games. I’m not sure he knows exactly how he’s gonna navigate that, but let’s just look at the good QB and top-end talent and kinda distract ourselves from those red flags; it’ll probably work out somehow.
blurbs.nick-dakshots-at-the-hampton-inn: Securing the number one overall player at any pick later than number one is always going to look good, then getting two solid RBs with upside, a TE with upside, and lots of startable options at WR make this team look even nicer. I think my main problem is everyone is just kinda fine, like there’s no inherent problem with this team, I just look at all the other teams above it and I’m like “Damn! Hell yeah!” and I look at Nick’s and I’m like “alright cool, thumbs up I guess.” A nice double in the gap.
blurbs.alex-she-maye-gibbs-me-head: There’s a world where having the best TE, a lot of high-floor, high-ceiling breakout WRs, and a potential top-tier RB makes this team a championship contender. There’s also a world where none of that happens and Drake Maye is bad and I have no RB2. Let’s take some risks, baby! The wings don’t scare me (he says, lying)!
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v8: Rocco went in only focusing on vibes and not worrying about fantasy analysis or any of that bullshit, and he ended up scooping up good value and building a solid foundation to a good team. Now, the average age of his starting RBs is 29, but we’ll just push that to the side and pretend we didn’t see it.
blurbs.steven-i-am-a-stupid-idiot: Last year, Steven took four WRs before taking his first RB, and drafted Zamir White as his starting RB2. This year, he learned a bit from his mistakes, only drafting three WRs before taking his first RB. It might not seem like much, but every journey begins with just a single step. Maybe this means he’ll eat 2 wings next year?
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: “Oooh look at me, I’m Connor, I just had an amazing wedding with all of my friends and family and now I’m travelling the world with my wife who loves me and I just won fantasy last year and I had the best draft this year despite the fact that I was drafting from a hotel in southwestern Africa” man fuck you.

draft.intro: As we as a group get better and better at fantasy drafting, these rankings get harder and harder. This is definitely the hardest draft rankings I’ve had to do yet; there really isn’t much that separates rank 12 from rank 1 this year. However, I had to pick nits and find ways to rank all 12 teams, so enjoy, and I can’t wait until all of this is completely null and void after week 1.

week-1.label: Week 1

blurbs.matt-the-team-formerly-known-as-jeanty-i: A performance as poor and baffling as the team’s name. On the bright side, Matt’s going to change up his lineup next week and start Coleman and Javonte. I can’t wait for them to put up duds and have every bench player outscore them!
blurbs.richard-the-pollard-express: Honestly, for how many dogshit performances Rich’s team had, 79 points, some bench pop offs, and 1 place off a median win is really not bad. I still don’t have a lot of faith in this team, and having multiple players tied to Tua Tagovailoa in 2025 is just a disaster waiting to happen (and that’s if you think last week wasn’t a disaster), but there’s actually reasons to be optimistic despite the shittiness. Might need to look for a new tight end though.
blurbs.nick-dakshots-at-the-hampton-inn: The 12-point swing of DJ Moore being wide open for a touchdown to seal Nick’s win, only for Caleb to miss him by a good 10 yards, and then Moore didn’t catch the final touchdown because he was injured, and then Moore fumbled the ball on the final play of the game, feels pretty emblematic of Nick’s fantasy luck over the past few years. Also, only 3.6 for Chase? That guy sucks. You should probably trade him to me.
blurbs.tyler-team-strong-2025: We all made fun of Tyler’s team for being too old, and then in week 1 they showed us exactly who they are by looking as old as we thought they would. Also, the last second decision to start Lawrence over Fields probably cost Ty a median win and might be crucial in the back half of the season. Or it won’t matter because his team is so far out of a playoff spot that one win won’t make a difference. Who’s to say?
blurbs.steven-i-am-a-stupid-idiot: We thought we were back, but it turns out it has never been so over. Drafting for value is stupid and overrated; Ken Walker can’t play, Puka’s getting concussed, Russ can’t cook for shit, and Steven’s bench nearly outscored his starters. At least Brock Purdy did well and is definitely playing next week… right?
blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v8: At the end of the year, they don’t ask how you got the wins, they just ask how many. Sure, Rocco’s best player only got 1 yard over his projections, and sure, his only bench RB was just traded to be a kick returner, and sure, his 6th-round QB played like shit against last year’s worst team, and sure, Rocco’s gonna have start-sit dilemmas every week with his 2 QBs, and sure, Matthew Golden only got 2 points; but, Rocco played this week’s worst team, and that’s all that really matters.
blurbs.austin-cyborg-squad: Well, I’ll be damned. Sometimes you have to tip your cap and admit when you’re wrong, and maybe I should have had more faith that rostering the 3 best players on the league’s best offense would lead to fantasy points. Even with a guy getting negative points, the Cyborg Squad was the top-scoring team. I mean fuck, Zach Ertz even scored on his bench. I’ll still maintain my original opinion of this team and I’m not ready to eat the humble pie just yet, but I can see it warming up in the oven and I’m starting to sweat.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: It turns out trusting a 29-year-old running back with degenerative bilateral achilles tendonitis was actually a smart thing to do; who knew? When you’re looking through your lineup, and you choose to start Kyle Pitts, and it works, that’s how you know you aren’t losing this week. Even with a few duds, Cam’s team looks promising. You just have to hope that one stray tackle doesn’t derail McCaffrey’s season. That would just be awful.
blurbs.xander-he-bleeds-pink: The Smith brothers completely fucking up their draft bot mid-draft and having low-tier squads only to be the top 2 scorers and have the best 2 players of the week is just the perfect cherry on top of week one. Xander’s gonna have to find a Kittle replacement for the next few weeks, and his top flex players all underperformed, so this celebration might be short-lived. But, eh, it’s fine, we’ll just ignore that for now and focus on the good vibes. 2-0 baby!

If these performances are consistent, this is a strong playoff team through and through. week-1.intro: As we venture into the first week of the fantasy season, I wanted to go through what worked and what didn’t in last year’s blog. The player performances based on projections, despite Matt’s objections, were among my favorite additions, so I’m keeping them, but feel free to let me know what improvements could be added. Also, the week 1 rankings are always the most volatile, so I made a hard and fast rule not to change anyone’s ranking by more than 6 (half the league). If you think a ranking deserves to be higher or lower, that rule is likely why it’s not. Enjoy!

blurbs.rocco-team-of-bums-v8: After the toxic and tumultuous love affair I had with Rocco’s team last season, it’s nice to know that this year there was never any spark between us. Sure, I thought she was cute from across the bar when I ranked her 3rd after the draft, but then it was last call and the lights turned on, and I saw that only 2 players all season have performed over their projections by 0.7 total points, so I pretended we never made eye contact and got the hell out of there.
blurbs.matt-the-team-formerly-known-as-jeanty-i: This is more of a courtesy ranking, as I felt obligated to rank Matt ahead of Rocco after last week’s performances, but trust me when I say if I could rank this team lower I would. Currently, with Burrow out for the entire fantasy regular season, and all three of Ladd, Jeanty, and Nico underperforming expectations up to this point, it’s hard to look forward and be positive about this team. At least Cooper Kupp looked good!
blurbs.tyler-team-strong-2025: After two straight weeks of Tyler’s team scoring under 75 points, he continues his slow and gradual descent down the power rankings. The silver lining is the old players all played well this week, with Adams, Barkley, and Hill all meeting or beating their projections. However, getting less than 10 points combined from your QB, TE, and two FLEX spots is just like Tyler’s effort running the bases when he thought he hit a homer in softball only to hit the fence: PATHETIC!
blurbs.nick-dakshots-at-the-hampton-inn: In true Nick fashion, he puts up the 3rd-most points in the week only to lose to one of the two teams that outscored him, and his first-round pick just lost his QB for 12 weeks. There are plenty of reasons to look at this team and be optimistic, like that Chase scored 30 in a game where Burrow left halfway through, and Warren is a stud, and Dak showed he can put up good games. But, 1-3 after 2 weeks with an insecure RB room would make me a bit queasy. Can’t wait for the inevitable other injuries that will plague this team.
blurbs.richard-the-pollard-express: Here ya go, Rich: I’m finally ranking your team inside the single digits. After some reflection, even though Rich went 0-2 in week 1, I was a little harsh on his team’s ranking. Mahomes finally looks like he’s not a dogshit fantasy QB, Juwan Johnson is kinda going crazy, and Achane proved that (when Tua plays) he is him. The rest of the team is kinda suspect still but this is a culture win, we build off of this and move forward.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: Not exactly what we were looking for in week 2 Cam, to have not a single player outscore projections, and to make the wrong start/sit decision between Rhamondre and Tracy, which lost you the median this week. You gotta hope Hurts starts putting things together, otherwise yikes. At least Egbuka, Skattebo, and Pitts are actually Him-othee Chalamet.
blurbs.austin-cyborg-squad: Austin and the Cyborg Squad still pulled out a dub even after a down week. Although the roster management is poor (Mostert still on the team, Aiyuk on the bench and not IR, Kaleb Johnson still in the lineup with a negative point total), the starting lineup is looking real nice right now. Maybe I should have had more faith in the Machine v2.5 because its teams are starting to make me nervous. The humble pie is out of the oven and it’s looking really tasty…
blurbs.liam-rasheez-nuts: Boy, did I get way over my skis with Liam’s team or what? Now we see the potential catastrophic risks of starting two Jets players at the same time. That, alongside A.J. Brown not being very good, and Jayden Daniels potentially not playing next week due to injury, makes me weary of this team in the coming weeks. Brighter days await Liam, with BILL now the starter in Washington and his bench receivers getting out of jail soon. I just gotta really take the L on this one; he said he didn’t want the hype because his team couldn’t live up to it and he was right.
blurbs.steven-i-am-a-stupid-idiot: We are so back. In fact, we couldn’t be more back than we are right now. Top scorer of the week, seven of eight starters got into the end zone, Kraft over Kelce was the right call and it didn’t even matter, and Ken Walker was even great off the bench. Is Daniel Jones actually gonna be good all season? Is Tee Higgins donezo with no more Burrow? Was Harvey a bust draft pick? Shut up, who cares! We’re back baby.
blurbs.xander-he-bleeds-pink:
HE. BLEEDS. PINK.

Just like Xander on the softball field, showing intense grit, determination, and effort, his fantasy team pulled out a great performance, only to lose in the end. Even with Allen playing like crap and Kittle hurt, the team had a great week; Xander’s bench nearly outscored Liam’s starters, and that’s including a 0.0 from an injured Kittle. Even with Jones hurt, plenty to like going forward for the Xan Man. WHO NEEDS STITCHES??
blurbs.alex-she-maye-gibbs-me-head: I did want to rank myself at the top spot, believe me, but journalistic integrity compelled me not to. I’m the only 4-0 team, sure, and I’m charming and handsome and cool and have the best batting average on our softball team behind Sara; that’s all true. But I wouldn’t rank another team number 1 with two straight 90-point weeks, so it’s only fair I don’t do it for mine. Odunze, Tet, and JSN might all actually be straight up DUDES, I just need an RB2. So, if anyone has one to spare, please hit my line. Like, please.
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: He took a one-week hiatus, but Connor reclaims his top spot in the rankings. There’s not much to say that I haven’t already said about Connor’s team, but when your 5th-round pick is out due to injury, and you start 2 TEs that combine for 3.4 points, and you still put up the 2nd-highest score of the week, that’s how you know your team is going to be a problem. With Quinshon now getting the bulk of the work for Cleveland, this team looks very scary to face right now.

I mean normally it takes a few more weeks for him to completely shit the bed; this is some all time assery going on right now. On top of virtually everyone on his team being mediocre and his best player getting 0 points and likely missing some time, Rocco started the Browns’ backup TE as his flex. Even having the best player this week, Rocco still went 0-2. Things are bleak.
blurbs.matt-the-team-formerly-known-as-jeanty-i: Matt needs to thank his lucky stars that Rocco’s team 1) also shit the bed this week and 2) lost its best player for a while, because otherwise this team has all the makings of a wing eater. His FRP averages under 8 a game, his QB is out for the year, and he chose the third target on the Chargers in the 3rd round. Matt’s team isn’t Jeanty-ing his pants, they’re shitting in them, and at every opportunity.
blurbs.richard-the-pollard-express: Just when we thought the culture was turning around, the Pollard Express hit a stray block of ice in the tracks and came to a screeching halt. Mahomes is back to being mid, Chase Brown was hitting road blocks with every carry, and Rich is currently paying $44.4 FAAB per point for Troy Franklin. Maybe naming your team after a Christmas movie when it’s still September is a bad omen; there’s not enough ice and snow for the Pollard Express to get going yet!
blurbs.tyler-team-strong-2025: Just like Tyler hitting a home run in softball, Ty’s team took a few weeks, but they’re back on track. Andrews and Sutton made up for some dogshit performances by going nuclear this week and almost singlehandedly secured the median win for Tyler, and Davante does not look old at all. Just need to figure out the QB situation and not start a backup against one of football’s best defenses next week.
blurbs.austin-cyborg-squad: Two down weeks in a row has me putting that humble pie back in the fridge to cool down. That, plus Austin losing his 3rd-round pick for the rest of the season, and the fact that he just has 2 empty bench spots, plus Henry fumbling for the 3rd game in a row, leads to a Cyborg downfall in the rankings. Look at the bright side: at least Kaleb Johnson didn’t get you negative points this week!
blurbs.liam-rasheez-nuts: What a fall from grace. It was not that long ago I ranked this team at number 1, now look at us. The nuts are giving me severe blue balls; I know this team could be great, but we still haven’t seen it yet. Maybe I should be kinder to this team; Daniels should be healthy, Addison is back from jail this week, and had Liam just played Hunter Henry over Njoku he’d have been 2-0 and right back on track. At this point in Leicester’s Premier League title charge, they got kicked in the mouth 2-5 by Arsenal; maybe this wake-up call is just what this team needs!
blurbs.steven-i-am-a-stupid-idiot: Just when we thought we were so back, we changed our team name to some bullshit about Daniel Jones and it is now, in fact, so over. Even if he visited Austin’s weird A.I. recipe site he tried recommending us after getting hacked, Russ still can’t cook for shit. Calvin Ridley is turbo mega ass. Tee Higgins has no QB. Kraft is hurt. Despite this, the team, at its core, is still solid, and has the capability of going absolutely crazy like in week 2. I just need some consistency, Steve.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: It wasn’t the most convincing performance, and you did just trade away Skattebo to a handsome manager, and this is the third week in a row that you’ve made the wrong start/sit decision regarding Rhamondre and Tracy, but by golly Cameron, you still eked out the 2-0 week, and that’s all we’re asking for from ya. Is there stability and security with most of your players? Not really, but there isn’t for most teams, so we’ll probably figure something out.
blurbs.nick-dakshots-at-the-hampton-inn: Nick is this week’s big riser after two straight solid performances. I know week 1 was a full on Nick game, but looking at his team now, it seems… good? As in, the luck is on the other foot now, and instead of Nick’s players getting injured, now three of his RBs have had injuries to their competition, resulting in more opportunities for Nick’s team? And even though the WRs and Dak have been bad, the team is still kind of winning? Eventually the luck will fade and Nick will suck again… right?
blurbs.xander-he-bleeds-pink: The top tier of the three best teams seem to be separating themselves from the pack already. Xander spent $70 FAAB on Quentin Johnston and that’s working out for him. He drafted two Commanders WRs that are underperforming and it’s not affecting anything. His TE and RB2 are injured and it doesn’t matter. The pink blood oozing out of his open wounds is striking fear in his opponents, and they can’t handle the Allen/Taylor combo. Maybe the Machine v2.5 was onto something this year…
blurbs.alex-she-maye-gibbs-me-head: We knew a win was coming this week for me, since I’m now 10-1 against Matt all time (not counting the win I just got in our dynasty league this week) and he just can’t handle my swag. RB2 was my one hole, and now that I have an absolute crayon-eating, CTE monster as my RB2, the league is on notice. Bowers is kinda hurt, and I’m having QB start dilemmas, and I have limited depth, sure, I’ll give that to you; things aren’t perfect. But it’s nice to shut the haters that questioned my record *cough cough* Nick up by being this week’s top scorer. Surely I won’t screw this up somehow by doing some kind of dumb trade, haha…
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: As much as I wanted to put myself top, Connor’s team just keeps pulling out big wins each week. I mean hell, his worst player had 75 yards receiving. And I don’t know why we convinced ourselves to give him Quinshon Judkins in the goddamned 12th round, we could have just given him some random TE somewhere and he wouldn’t have known the difference. Connor has 3 good RBs, 2 good QBs, and Worthy is coming back soon; could we see our first back-to-back champ in quite a while? (I mean, it’s probably way too early for me to be saying that stuff, but for dramatic effect don’t you want me to end the post with some crazy proclamation?)

blurbs.austin-cyborg-squad: Yet another down week for Austin’s team; that humble pie is going into the freezer until further notice. blurbs.matt-the-team-formerly-known-as-jeanty-i: After Rocco graced his team with not getting last for multiple weeks in a row, Matt’s team finally picks up the slack and climbs up the ranks. Sure, we have zero wins vs. median on the year, but we’re not worried about that yet. Jeanty is finally good, and made Matt “Jeanty his pants” (his words, not mine) after the second touchdown. There’s not much to look forward to regarding the rest of Matt’s roster, but at least Jeanty is okay now… hopefully.
blurbs.steven-i-am-a-stupid-idiot: I supposed last week when I asked for consistency I should have been more clear: I meant consistently good, not consistently dogshit. Now, I could take more time to talk about how you played Daniel Jones this week and he was bad, or that your flex players are bad, or that you unironically played Chris Rodriguez, but instead I’ll use this space to dedicate a prayer circle for Malik Nabers and his ACL. Malik’s knee died, and likely Steven’s season with it; incredibly unfortunate there for Stevie-D and the Giants. Rest up, king. Fly high.
blurbs.richard-the-pollard-express: The train needed some repairs, but she’s back on track, slowly but surely. Mahomes is good again, Metcalf finally got more than 4 catches in a game, and Chase Brown didn’t throw up a complete dud like in week 3. As the months get colder and the ice starts to thicken, maybe the Pollard Express will pick up more steam. Just don’t leave your drink roster unattended around Rich; he might slip something in it.
blurbs.tyler-team-strong-2025: What an unfortunate weekend for Tyler: his dad came to watch us lose 23-6 in softball, Tyreek likely tore his ACL, and he was the third-highest scorer and couldn’t go 2-0. On the bright side, basically everyone on Tyler’s team was good this week; even Justice Hill on his bench went crazy. We just might need to see a trade for a WR pretty soon.
blurbs.nick-dakshots-at-the-hampton-inn: Right when we thought this team would turn things around, the luck is back in the toilet. I still think this team has a lot of promise going forward, but we’ll need to see better performances from the top players. Perhaps the big names can turn things around and carry this team to victory each week? Bengals’ offense looking as bad as it looks spells disaster for the number two pick, you need to hope that changes. Omarion is incredible, but Zero consistency from the rest of the players may spell disaster in the coming weeks. One has to hope things change, and quickly. 😉
blurbs.liam-rasheez-nuts: Just like Leicester getting that punch in the mouth, that was exactly the motivation Liam’s team needed to turn things around. Even though A.J. Brown is a complete disaster, the title charge is well and truly back. Liam’s pick of Bijan over Chase continues to prove me wrong each day, and with both Daniels and the titular RashEe coming back very soon, I see bright things in Liam’s future. We just need to hope he doesn’t play another Arsenal and have a Danny Welbeck last-minute header to derail his title charge once again.
blurbs.alex-she-maye-gibbs-me-head: Smokin’ on that Nick pack this week. Down week and I’m still winning. Have to give respect to the teams with more points than me on the year, but after the CD trade we’re looking primed for a good run this year *knocks on wood*.
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: After giving up Skattebo for nothing (thanks boo), making the wrong flex start for the 4th straight game, and feeling incredibly unsure about his team going into the week, Cam ends up with a stellar rivalry week performance. Can we count on Pitts and Harrison each week? Will Egbuka break another Looney Toons TD every game? Probably not, but you have to reward the balls of taking two old ass RBs and no WRs til round 4, and having it work extremely well so far. Maybe Cam has finally graduated from Protege to Master?
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: It does hurt a little bit to put Connor’s team at the number two spot, despite having a good week and a great outlook for the rest of the year. But, the margins are thin at the top, and the power rankings are cutthroat and extremely serious. Still, the WRs are incredible, the RBs look great, Worthy is back and looking good, and even Godwin is back healthy; if there’s one team I’m jealous of so far, it’s this one. Maybe this ranking will put a chip on Connor’s team’s shoulder and they’ll play even better next week?
blurbs.xander-he-bleeds-pink: A new king sits atop the power rankings throne. Maybe this is a bit rash, but there are currently no discernable holes in Xander’s team. He picked up Ferguson to replace Kittle and he ended up just being straight up better, he has the top QB, two great RBs, and his WRs are currently in very fortunate injury situations. The injury bug has hit Xander’s 3rd and 4th-round picks and it hasn’t hampered him even a tiny bit. Now, last time Xander was first in the rankings, his team was complete trash and pitifully collapsed as the dog days of the season arrived. So, here’s to hoping it’s different this time, I guess?

blurbs.steven-i-am-a-stupid-idiot: A nice bounceback win for Steven with his ever-changing stupid Indiana Jones name. Look, is it sustainable to win off the back of a Rico Dowdle 200-yard game? No, but the WRs finally look good, and Warren will be back soon, and Steven has two good TEs for some reason. So like, maybe this will be fine, and missing Nabers won’t be a big deal? I mean, I don’t actually believe that, but maybe this week provides some high-tier copium for Steven.
blurbs.matt-the-team-formerly-known-as-jeanty-i: After Matt’s dogshit start to the season, he finally has a win against the median, and things are starting to look up. It’s probably more accurate to change the team name to Javonte In My Pants, since drafting him is probably un-ironically the best decision you’ve made this calendar year (right behind inviting Chantal home from Gilligan’s and meeting “the one” - congrats on finding the love of your life Matt!)
blurbs.richard-the-pollard-express: The train just keeps on rollin’. Funnily, the team has swapped: we thought the QB and WRs would be the weak point, and the RBs would be the strong point, but now it looks like the RBs are less reliable than the WRs and QB. Funny how fantasy can work like that.
blurbs.liam-rasheez-nuts: Even with an 0-2 week and a losing record on the year, it’s hard to be pessimistic. Bijan was on a bye and median was missed by only a touchdown, Jayden is back, and Rashee is so close to coming back we can almost taste it. Even though AJ Brown fucking blows, the rest of the team is set up really nicely for the rest of the season. Maybe I wasn’t wrong about Liam’s team being number one, I was just wayyyyyy too early!
blurbs.alex-she-maye-gibbs-me-head: LISTEN! We’re having a bit of a skid right now, but it’s what we thought would happen! Injuries, byes, and a CeeDee Lamb trade meant I was always going to lose this week! So it’s fine! All of you stop worrying! The team is good and there are no problems! Pay no attention to the man behind the curtain!
blurbs.nick-dakshots-at-the-hampton-inn: Last week we thought it was RIP BOZO, but I guess after this week we’re back? It’s hard to feel super optimistic after losing Hampton for 4 weeks, but I guess Michael Carter will pick up the slack? Sure, Dak won’t play the Jets every week, but I guess he’s back to normal? Not a lot of consistency with the WRs but, who needs it?
blurbs.connor-new-year-chris-leak: A rare off week for Connor’s team, especially in a week where scoring was way up, sees his slide down the rankings continue. I guess when James Cook doesn’t score 20+ points, the luster on this team begins to fade. I still have faith this is but a blip in the story of Connor’s team, but I’d be remiss not to rank him accordingly. At least Worthy is back!
blurbs.cameron-scott-hanson-s-protege: Well, Cam’s ascension from Protege to Master is happening rapidly in front of our very eyes. Who knew ending your draft with a bunch of washed RBs that you as the drafter don’t even think are any good was the proper draft strategy? It also should not be lost on us that this is the first week of the season Cameron has finally made the correct start/sit decision in his final flex spot, and it happens to be the week he was the top scorer. Coincidence?
blurbs.xander-he-bleeds-pink: Xander retains his spot on the throne for a second straight week. Even with some underperformances and some injuries, things are just working out great for the Xan man right now: his D&D character narrowly escaped death this week, he has the best fantasy team with the best fantasy RB so far, and the girl he has a crush on is newly single 👀 (don’t think we didn’t all see that canoodling under the blanket big dog). All of these things have left me with only one word to say: MORE!
